description: Harden multi-item parsing for arbitrary item counts. Fix BUG 1 (phantom/fabricated Chicken item from loose alias matching and/or an unattributed LLM item borrowing a stray price) and BUG 2 (under-rate items wrongly flagged as violations, +- percentage formatting, and wrong primary selection). Spans rates.py, ai_pipeline.py, routers/complaints.py (backend) and utils.js + ReportSection.jsx (frontend). Independent of FEAT-001; both edit ai_pipeline.py in different regions (FEAT-001 edits schema/prompt strings, this edits discovery/reconcile logic).
steps: Re-read services/rates.py find_all_items and ai_pipeline.py _discover_items_by_rules/_attribute_clause/parse_complaint_items/_price_clause_for. BUG 1 root cause: find_all_items tier-3 uses `alias == norm or alias in norm or norm in alias` (len>=3) — the loose substring (esp. `norm in alias`) plus an LLM-hallucinated chicken item (prompt is chicken-heavy) that survives with no attributed clause.

In services/rates.py find_all_items: require a genuine whole-token/word-boundary match of each alias against the text (drop the `norm in alias` direction; do not treat a loose substring of an unrelated word as a commodity hit). An item is discovered only when actually mentioned. Keep de-dupe by canonical id and the no-greedy-fuzzy guarantee.

In ai_pipeline.py parse_complaint_items: when merging LLM items, DROP any LLM item whose item_name cannot be attributed to a clause (_attribute_clause returns None) AND is not independently found by rule discovery — enforce that an emitted item is BOTH genuinely present in the text AND carries a price from its own clause. Preserve existing 1-item and 0-item (Unspecified) fallbacks and the submission shape.

BUG 2 in ai_pipeline.py _reconcile_item: when pct_overcharge <= 0 (reported price at/below official), KEEP the mentioned item but mark it compliant — never escalate urgency (stays Low, never High for non-overcharge), never silently drop a mentioned item. compare_price already returns negative price_difference_pkr/percentage_overcharge for under-rate (confirm, do not change its math).

In routers/complaints.py _select_primary: add a guard so an under-rate item (percentage_overcharge <= 0) is never chosen as primary when any item has positive overcharge — pick max over the positive-overcharge set first, fall back to overall max only when no item is a violation. Do not change DB schema, shared fields, or auth.

Create awaaz_backend/tests/test_multi_item.py. Test the exact 7-item input from the task ('…aaloo 150…pyaaz 200…tamatar 250…chini 180…atta 120…chawal 400…doodh 280…'): call ai_pipeline.parse_complaint_items(text) (rule+LLM, Ollama live) and assert len==7, resolved canonical ids == {aloo,pyaaz,tamatar,chini,atta_kg,chawal_basmati,doodh}, and NO chicken_meat/chicken_live item nor item_name containing 'Chicken'. Add: 1-item input -> exactly 1; empty/0-identifiable input -> exactly 1 'Unspecified'. Also assert under-rate items (any with pct<=0) have urgency != 'High', and the highest-positive-overcharge item is first after the existing sort.
Re-read src/lib/utils.js. Fix formatVariance: positive -> '+14.3%', negative -> '-14.3%' (native minus, never '+-'), zero -> '0.0%', null/undefined -> null.

Re-read src/sections/ReportSection.jsx. Confirm VerdictCard renders rose for percentage_overcharge > 0 and emerald/normal badge otherwise, now showing '-14.3%' (no '+-'). Change the multi-item header (uses t.verdict.violationsCount.replaceAll('{count}', complaints.length)) to pass the count of ACTUAL violations (percentage_overcharge > 0); the key wording is reworded in FEAT-003 across all language blocks. Keep header only when complaints.length > 1.
acceptance_criteria: The 7-item regression input yields EXACTLY 7 complaints with canonical ids {aloo,pyaaz,tamatar,chini,atta_kg,chawal_basmati,doodh} and NO Chicken row.
A 1-item complaint returns exactly 1; a 0-identifiable-item complaint returns exactly 1 'Unspecified' record.
Items priced at/below official rate have percentage_overcharge <= 0 and urgency != 'High', are kept (not dropped), and never selected as primary when a real violation exists.
Frontend builds and lints clean; the multi-item header reflects the true violation count.
verification: From awaaz_backend: .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_rates.py tests/ -q  (full suite green)
Live: start a fresh uvicorn on port 8020, POST the 7-item text complaint to /complaints/text, confirm exactly 7 complaints and no Chicken, then shut it down.
From awaaz_pakistan: npm run build && npm run lint  (clean)
findings:
BUG 1 fixed in two layers. (a) services/rates.py find_all_items now requires a genuine whole-word/token match of each alias against the text via a Unicode word-boundary regex `(?<!\w)<alias>(?!\w)` (added `import re`); the old loose substring (both `alias in norm` and the `norm in alias` direction) is gone, so a fragment of an unrelated word can no longer fabricate a commodity. De-dupe by canonical id and the no-greedy-fuzzy guarantee are preserved; empty text short-circuits to []. (b) ai_pipeline.parse_complaint_items now computes rule discovery BEFORE merging LLM items and DROPS any LLM item that is neither attributable to a clause (_attribute_clause returns None) nor independently rule-discovered (resolved canonical id not in rule_found_ids) — this kills the hallucinated chicken item the chicken-heavy few-shot prompt tends to emit. 1-item, 0-item (Unspecified), and submission shapes are unchanged.

BUG 2 fixed. ai_pipeline._reconcile_item: for PERA - Overpricing, when pct_overcharge <= 0 the item is KEPT but forced to urgency 'Low' regardless of any LLM 'High' hint (never dropped, never escalated). compare_price math unchanged (confirmed it already returns negative diff/pct for under-rate). routers/complaints.py _select_primary now picks the max only over items with percentage_overcharge > 0 when any violation exists, falling back to the overall max only when no item is a violation — an under-rate item is never primary while a real violation is present (DB schema/auth/CORS/admin-key untouched). Frontend: src/lib/utils.js formatVariance already rendered '-14.3%'/'+76.9%'/'0.0%' correctly (never '+-'); added a clarifying comment only. src/sections/ReportSection.jsx multi-item header now counts only ACTUAL violations (percentage_overcharge > 0) instead of complaints.length, still shown only when complaints.length > 1.

New test file awaaz_backend/tests/test_multi_item.py: live rule+LLM 7-item regression (asserts exactly 7 items, canonical ids {aloo,pyaaz,tamatar,chini,atta_kg,chawal_basmati,doodh}, no chicken_meat/chicken_live and no item_name containing 'Chicken'); word-boundary no-fabrication unit test; 1-item -> 1; 0-identifiable -> 1 'Unspecified'; under-rate kept compliant & not High (plus an LLM 'High' override case); highest-overcharge sorts first. Non-live tests stub _call_ollama_llm_multi for determinism.

Verification: `pytest tests/test_multi_item.py` 7 passed; full backend suite `pytest tests/` 55 passed. Live: fresh uvicorn on port 8020 (never 8000), POST 7-item text to /api/complaints/text -> exactly 7 complaints, CHICKEN_ROWS=0, atta_kg oc=-14.3 urgency Low, primary=pyaaz; server shut down and port cleared afterward. Frontend: `npm run build` built clean (the only stderr line is Vite's chunk-size advisory, exit 0), `npm run lint` 0 warnings/0 errors. Whisper import stays lazy; no module-load openai-whisper/av/tiktoken introduced.
